name: WhiteBIT Nova Card
summary: A Visa-enabled crypto debit card offering on-the-fly conversion from 12 supported cryptocurrencies to EUR for everyday spending.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required

faq.question: Does the WhiteBIT Nova Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the WhiteBIT Nova Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the WhiteBIT Nova Card require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
